the-genius-code.title: The Genius Code
the-genius-code.subtitle: The mind under God
the-genius-code.theme: The mind as a reservoir: preparation, decision, identity and excellence under God.

themeScripture.text: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

declaration: My mind is a gift from God, and I will keep it well.
Prayer and preparation work together, never against each other.
I refuse average and choose excellence in what God has given me.

weeks.title: Days 1–7
weeks.question: The mind as a reservoir: preparation, decision, identity and excellence under God.

weeks.title: Days 8–14
weeks.question: My mind is a gift from God, and I will keep it well.

weeks.title: Days 15–17
weeks.question: Prayer and preparation work together, never against each other.

1.title: Unlocking the goD CODE: How to Activate Your Spiritual Intelligence
1.truth: Spiritual intelligence grows as we seek God first and let His wisdom guide our thinking.
1.challenge: Ask God for one specific piece of wisdom and write down what you sense.
questions: Where do you most want God's wisdom to guide your thinking this week?

2.title: Decide to be 10x: How to Rise Above Mediocrity Daily
2.truth: Excellence is a daily decision to do ordinary tasks with care, attention and effort.
2.challenge: Do one routine task today with full attention and finish it well.
questions: Which ordinary task could you do with more care today, and why would that matter?

3.title: The Genius Code: How to Unlock Your Full Potential Today
3.truth: Your potential is unlocked by using what you have today, not by waiting for someday.
3.challenge: Use one gift or skill you have today in a small, real way.
questions: Which gift or skill are you waiting to use until a later day?

4.title: Unlock Your True Identity: The Genius Code
4.truth: Your true identity is rooted in who God says you are, not in your grades, talents or mistakes.
4.challenge: Write one thing God says about you and read it aloud before school or work.
questions: Which label have you been living under that God has never given you?

5.title: Decision Defines Direction: The Genius Code
5.truth: Small daily decisions set the direction your life travels long before big moments arrive.
5.challenge: Make one clear decision about your study, time or words, and stick to it.
questions: Which decision today is quietly setting your direction for next month?

6.title: The Science of Success: Cracking The Genius Code
6.truth: Success is built on steady habits of learning, practice and prayer, and those habits can be grown.
6.challenge: Spend 20 focused minutes on a skill you want to grow in.
questions: What steady practice could you begin this week to grow in something you care about?

7.title: The Transformer Mind: How to Output God’s Power in the Real World
7.truth: God's power shows up in real life when what we learn in prayer becomes everyday action.
7.challenge: Take one thing you have prayed about and act on it in a small way today.
questions: Where in your week could you put what you have learned from God into practice?

8.title: The Genius Code: Why Prayer Does Not Cancel Preparation
8.truth: Prayer and preparation belong together: we ask God for help and we also study and work hard.
8.challenge: Pray over a task, then spend 20 minutes preparing for it.
questions: What preparation are you neglecting while you wait for God to act?

9.title: The 3-2-1 Rule: How to Build an Excellent Mind (The Genius Code)
9.truth: A simple, repeatable rule practised daily trains the mind toward excellence one step at a time.
9.challenge: Write a simple three-part rule for your study or work time and try it today.
questions: What simple daily rule would help your mind focus, and what would it say?

10.title: Stop Waiting for the Test to Test Yourself!
10.truth: Do not wait for a test to find out what you know; check yourself regularly along the way.
10.challenge: Quiz yourself on one topic from this week without looking at your notes.
questions: What do you know well, and what do you need to check before the next test?

11.title: The Miracle of the Mind: Unlocking Your God-Given Intelligence
11.truth: The mind is a God-given gift, and it grows as we use it well.
11.challenge: Read one short passage today and tell someone one thing you learned.
questions: What would it look like to use your mind this week as a gift from God?

12.title: YOUR MIND is a RESERVOIR (Stop the Leak!)
12.truth: Your mind holds what you feed it, so guard what goes in and fill it with what builds you.
12.challenge: Close one input that drains your mind today and use that time for something that builds you.
questions: What leak in your mind, such as a habit or a voice, drains you each day?

13.title: You're NOT a GENIUS until you REFUSE AVERAGE
13.truth: Refusing average means choosing excellence in small things, even when no one is watching.
13.challenge: Raise your standard on one task today: neater, finished and on time.
questions: Where have you settled for average, and what would a higher standard look like?

14.title: You are not a GENIUS if you are Chasing this (LIGHT 1)
14.truth: Chasing the wrong things leaves even a talented person with little that lasts, so pursue what is true.
14.challenge: Write down what you are chasing this month and ask God to show you if it is right.
questions: What are you chasing right now, and does it lead toward what God values?

15.title: You are not a GENIUS until you can CHANGE things. (Light 2)
15.truth: A true mind does more than know; it brings good change to the people and places around you.
15.challenge: Do one small act today that improves something for someone else.
questions: What is one thing around you that could be better because of your effort?

16.title: You are not a GENIUS until people cant forget your NAME (Light 3)
16.truth: A life of kindness and integrity leaves a name people remember for good.
16.challenge: Speak one kind and honest word to someone today that they will remember.
questions: What do you want people to remember about your character, not only your talent?

17.title: You’re Not a Genius Until You Do This. (Light 4)
17.truth: An idea grows real when it is acted on; knowing about it is only the beginning.
17.challenge: Take the first concrete step on one idea before you go to bed tonight.
questions: Which idea or task have you known about but not started, and what is one first step?

power-of-positive-habits.title: The Power of Positive Habits
power-of-positive-habits.subtitle: Godly habits that hold
power-of-positive-habits.tagline: Replace the pattern, one day at a time.
power-of-positive-habits.theme: The habit loop, replacement not suppression, and building godly habits that hold.

themeScripture.text: Be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.

declaration: I can choose the habit I practise today.
God is able to renew my mind and reshape my habits.
I replace the old pattern with a godly one, one day at a time.

weeks.title: Days 1–7
weeks.question: The habit loop, replacement not suppression, and building godly habits that hold.

weeks.title: Days 8–14
weeks.question: I can choose the habit I practise today.

weeks.title: Days 15–17
weeks.question: God is able to renew my mind and reshape my habits.

1.title: STOP THE CYCLE: How to Master Your Choices and Build Godly Habits
1.truth: A habit cycle can be broken once you see it clearly and choose a different next step.
1.challenge: Write down one choice you make every day without really thinking about it.
questions: Which daily cycle keeps repeating in your life, and where does it usually start?

2.title: Your FLESH is a SLAVE; Rewire it in 21 Days (The Power of Positive Habits)
2.truth: Lasting change grows through steady repetition, not through one burst of willpower.
2.challenge: Choose one small godly action and do it at the same time tomorrow.
questions: What small thing could you repeat faithfully for the next few weeks?

3.title: I Am What I Choose: Building Positive Habits
3.truth: Your daily choices shape who you become, so choose with the person you are becoming in mind.
3.challenge: Make one choice today that matches the person you are becoming in Christ.
questions: Which choice this week would show the person you want to become?

4.title: The 4-Step Secret to Breaking Bad Habits (For Kids & Families)
4.truth: Breaking a bad habit is easier when the whole family knows the steps and supports each other.
4.challenge: Tell one trusted person which bad habit you are working on this week.
questions: Which step feels hardest for you, and how could a family member help with it?

5.title: The Habit Loop: Why Your Brain Needs a "Cue"
5.truth: Every habit starts with a cue, so noticing the trigger is the first step toward change.
5.challenge: Notice and write down the cue that comes before one habit today.
questions: What cue usually comes right before the habit you want to change?

6.title: CAN'T STOP CRAVING? The Habit Loop Explained.
6.truth: A craving follows a loop of cue, craving and reward, so you can interrupt it before it grows.
6.challenge: The next time a craving hits, pause and pray for one full minute before you act.
questions: When a craving hits, what do you normally do next, and what would be a wiser pause?

7.title: STOP THE CYCLE; How to Master Your Choices (The Habit Loop)
7.truth: Mastering your choices means interrupting the loop at the moment of choice, not after it ends.
7.challenge: Find one point in your day where you can choose differently, and choose it.
questions: At which point in your daily loop could you make a different choice?

8.title: Your Choices defines your CROWN (Habit Loop Part 5)
8.truth: Daily choices build character, and self-discipline now prepares you for a prize that lasts.
8.challenge: Choose one act of faithfulness today and thank God for it tonight.
questions: Which small choice this week is quietly building the character you want?

9.title: Visibility drives behavior (Laws of Habit- Part 1)
9.truth: What you see often shapes what you do, so make good habits easy to see and bad ones harder to reach.
9.challenge: Move one distraction out of sight and place one helpful reminder where you will see it.
questions: What in plain sight pulls you toward a habit you do not want?

10.title: The Creator Shift: Why Playing Games is Holding Your Genius Brain Back Forever. (Laws of Habit 2)
10.truth: Moving from only consuming to also creating puts your time and mind to better use.
10.challenge: Spend 15 minutes creating something instead of only consuming it.
questions: How could one hour of screen time turn into something you make, learn or give?

11.title: Habit Law: The Hidden Key to Consistent Growth
11.truth: Consistency, not intensity, is the hidden key that makes growth last.
11.challenge: Do your smallest good habit today, even if nothing else goes perfectly.
questions: Which small effort have you been tempted to skip, and what would faithfulness look like there?

12.title: Stop Making It Hard: Why You Struggle to Build Godly Habits Effortlessly
12.truth: Good habits become easier when you shrink them to something simple and make them part of your routine.
12.challenge: Shrink one godly habit to five minutes and do it today.
questions: Which godly habit have you made too big to start, and how could you make it smaller?

13.title: You Don't Rise to Your Goals: You Fall to Your Habits
13.truth: Under pressure we fall back on our habits, so the routines we build matter as much as our goals.
13.challenge: Write one simple daily habit that would carry you on a hard day.
questions: What simple daily habit would hold you steady on your hardest day?

14.title: Why You Can't Quit Bad Habits - Recognize
14.truth: You cannot quit what you do not recognise, so honestly naming a habit is where freedom starts.
14.challenge: Name one bad habit honestly in your journal or to a trusted adult today.
questions: Which bad habit have you been calling by a softer name, and what would honesty look like?

15.title: Stop Fighting Old Habits (Do This One Thing Instead)
15.truth: Instead of only fighting an old habit, replace it with one new action you choose on purpose.
15.challenge: Decide your replacement action now and write it where you will see it.
questions: What is one action you could choose instead when the old habit calls?

16.title: The Real Secret to Overcoming Sin: The Power of Replacement
16.truth: Replacing a harmful habit with a godly one holds better than simply trying to suppress it.
16.challenge: Pick one godly replacement and pray over it before the day begins.
questions: What good thing could fill the space when you leave a habit God is asking you to drop?

17.title: How Repetition Rewires Your Brain for positive Habits.
17.truth: Repeating a godly action over time makes it easier and more natural, step by step.
17.challenge: Repeat one positive action you already do, and notice how it feels today.
questions: Which positive action have you repeated enough that it now feels more natural?

the-voice-of-influence.title: The V.O.I.C.E. of Influence
the-voice-of-influence.subtitle: How influence is built
the-voice-of-influence.tagline: Value others. Use words that build.
the-voice-of-influence.theme: Value others, overlook offences, listen, create with words, extol humility: how influence is built.

themeScripture.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

declaration: I build influence by valuing others, not by seeking attention for myself.
I use my words to lift people up, and I listen before I speak.
I keep my integrity and my humility, because lasting influence rests on character.

weeks.title: Days 1–7
weeks.question: Value others, overlook offences, listen, create with words, extol humility: how influence is built.

weeks.title: Days 8–14
weeks.question: I build influence by valuing others, not by seeking attention for myself.

weeks.title: Days 15–21
weeks.question: I use my words to lift people up, and I listen before I speak.

1.title: The Ladder of Influence
1.truth: Influence grows one step at a time, through character and faithfulness rather than a single moment.
1.challenge: Do one small act of faithfulness today that no one will praise.
questions: What is the next step you can take to grow your influence for good?

2.title: Yesterday till FOREVER
2.truth: Your influence reaches beyond today, so the choices you make now echo into the future.
2.challenge: Choose one action today you would be glad to see repeated a thousand times.
questions: Which choice you make today could still matter in ten years?

3.title: The Power of CONVICTIONS
3.truth: Convictions are the beliefs you stand on when it costs you something, and they shape the influence you carry.
3.challenge: Write down one conviction you hold and one way you will live it out today.
questions: What conviction are you willing to live by even when it is unpopular?

4.title: ADVANCEMENT- multiplied Living
4.truth: Advancement that multiplies comes when your life blesses others, not only yourself.
4.challenge: Share one skill or insight with someone who could use it.
questions: How could your growth bless someone besides you this month?

5.title: GRACE - Legacy of Influence
5.truth: Grace given freely builds a legacy that outlives you, because people remember how they were treated.
5.challenge: Extend grace to someone who let you down and tell them you forgive them.
questions: How would you like people to remember the way you treated them?

6.title: ABUNDANCE - Legacy of Influence
6.truth: Abundance shared with others builds a legacy, because what we give away blesses people beyond ourselves.
6.challenge: Share something you have, whether food, time or help, with one person today.
questions: What abundance in your life could you share with someone this week?

7.title: LOYALTY to your Roots (LEGACY)
7.truth: Remembering where you come from and staying loyal to family and community builds a strong legacy.
7.challenge: Message an older relative and ask them one question about your family history.
questions: Which family or community values do you want to carry forward?

8.title: ANOINTING - VISION of Influence
8.truth: Anointing and vision work together: God sets people apart and shows them a purpose to pursue.
8.challenge: Write one sentence describing the future you want to help build.
questions: What vision has God given you that you are still growing into?

9.title: 5 TWEETS that Saved the World
9.truth: Small words, carefully chosen, can carry great influence, and the way we speak online matters.
9.challenge: Before you post or send anything today, check that it builds someone up.
questions: What would your words online look like if they were used to build people up?

10.title: STEADFASTNESS to your dreams
10.truth: Dreams are kept alive through steadfast effort, showing up again and again when progress is slow.
10.challenge: Spend twenty minutes today on one step of a dream you hold.
questions: Which dream do you need to keep working at even when it feels slow?

11.title: INTEGRITY before POWER
11.truth: Character must come before position; integrity is what makes power safe to hold.
11.challenge: Do the honest, right thing in one small matter today, even if no one checks.
questions: Where could you practise integrity in a small matter this week?

12.title: VISION - Leading People
12.truth: Good leaders help people see a clear direction and move toward it together.
12.challenge: Share one clear goal with someone close to you and ask for their thoughts.
questions: Who could you help see a clear next step, and how would you do it?

13.title: EXTOL HUMILITY - The V.O.I.C.E of Influence
13.truth: Humility lifts others higher and keeps influence rooted in service rather than pride.
13.challenge: Give credit to someone else for something good today.
questions: Where do you find it hardest to be humble, and what would humility look like there?

14.title: CREATE with WORDS - The V.O.I.C.E of Influence
14.truth: Words can build or break; choosing them with care lets you create hope, courage and understanding.
14.challenge: Write an encouraging note or message to one person and send it.
questions: What words could you use this week to encourage someone who needs them?

15.title: LISTEN more - The V.O.I.C.E of Influence
15.truth: Listening well is a form of love and a source of influence, because people trust those who hear them.
15.challenge: In your next conversation, ask one question and listen without interrupting.
questions: Who in your life needs you to listen more than you speak right now?

16.title: OVERLOOK Offenses - The V.O.I.C.E of Influence
16.truth: Overlooking an offence is a choice that protects relationships and gives others room to grow.
16.challenge: Let one small offence go today and do not bring it up again.
questions: Which offence are you holding onto, and what would it look like to release it?

17.title: Value Others - The V.O.I.C.E of Influence
17.truth: Valuing others, by seeing them and treating them as important, is the foundation of lasting influence.
17.challenge: Learn one thing about someone you rarely talk to and show them you noticed.
questions: Who do you tend to overlook, and how could you show them they matter?

18.title: SKILLS - How Influence grows
18.truth: Skills, developed and used to serve, make your influence grow in ways that help others.
18.challenge: Practise one skill for twenty minutes and share one thing you learned.
questions: Which skill are you building, and who could it help?

19.title: EMOTIONS - How Influence grows
19.truth: Managing your emotions well builds trust, because calm and kind people are easier to follow.
19.challenge: When strong emotion rises today, pause and take three slow breaths before you respond.
questions: Which emotion most often gets in the way of your influence, and what helps you calm down?

20.title: ETHICS - How to have Influence
20.truth: Ethics guide how influence is used; doing what is right keeps it trustworthy and good.
20.challenge: Check one decision today against a standard of honesty and fairness.
questions: Which ethical standard matters most to you when you make a hard decision?

21.title: A GOOD NAME - How to have Influence
21.truth: A good name is built over time, is worth more than wealth, and opens doors that money cannot.
21.challenge: Do one thing today that you would be proud for people to remember you by.
questions: What do you want people to say about your name when you are not in the room?

rhythm-of-a-praying-life.title: The Rhythm of a Praying Life
rhythm-of-a-praying-life.subtitle: Prayer as breathing
rhythm-of-a-praying-life.tagline: Pray with boldness, keys and rhythm.
rhythm-of-a-praying-life.theme: How to pray with boldness, keys and rhythm, from Jesus’ own pattern.
declaration: I pray because I am in relationship with my Father.
I pray with a rhythm that fits every season, in success and in hard times.
I pray boldly and in faith, and I trust God with the answer.

1.title: Why Prayer Is Spiritual Breathing: The Power of a Praying Child of God
1.truth: Prayer is as natural to the believer as breathing: constant, needed and life-giving.
1.challenge: Pray one short sentence every time you pause today.
questions: What would change if you prayed as often as you breathe?

2.title: The First 5 Minutes of Prayer: The Secret Code for Instant Results
2.truth: The first minutes of prayer set the tone for the whole conversation with God, so begin with thanks.
2.challenge: Spend the first five minutes of prayer thanking God before you ask for anything.
questions: How do you usually begin your prayers, and how could you begin them better?

3.title: Answered Every Time? The 2-Step Prayer Code for Total Alignment
3.truth: Confident prayer comes from lining your requests up with God's will, then trusting Him with the timing.
3.challenge: Write your prayer request as one line, then check it against one verse.
questions: Where do you need to align your request with what God has said in His Word?

4.title: Your Prayers isnt BLOCKED, it's missing these 2 Keys
4.truth: When prayer feels stuck, bring that honestly to God instead of giving up; He welcomes an honest heart.
4.challenge: Tell God honestly where prayer feels stuck, then pray one sentence about it.
questions: When has prayer felt stuck for you, and what might you tell God about it?

5.title: How to Pray with Authority: The Connect-Expect-Surrender Method
5.truth: Connect with God, expect Him to act, then surrender the outcome to Him: a simple rhythm for bold prayer.
5.challenge: Pray through the three steps, one line each, about one thing today.
questions: Which step, connect, expect or surrender, do you find hardest, and why?

6.title: S.T.A.N.D.F.A.S.T - 9 Steps to Answered Prayer
6.truth: Standing firm in prayer means steady, practised steps with God at the centre, not a formula that forces an answer.
6.challenge: Pray slowly through one steady step today, asking God what to focus on.
questions: What helps you stand firm in prayer when it feels hard?

7.title: Prayer That Works: Aligning Your Mind and Neutralizing Doubt
7.truth: Doubt weakens prayer, and a mind set on God's promises helps you pray with steady confidence.
7.challenge: Name one doubt, then read a promise of God that speaks to it.
questions: What doubt do you bring to prayer, and which promise of God answers it?

8.title: Dwell on the word and Fix your confession
8.truth: Prayer grows when God's Word fills your thinking, and your spoken words agree with what He has promised.
8.challenge: Read one verse slowly and speak one sentence back to God that agrees with it.
questions: What verse could you dwell on this week, and what would you like your words to say about your life?

9.title: S.T.A.N.D.F.A.S.T: The Prayer KEYS That Unlock Answers
9.truth: The keys of prayer are steps you can practise, not magic; they open a faithful conversation with God.
9.challenge: Practise one prayer key today and write down how it felt.
questions: Which prayer key would you like to practise until it becomes a habit?

10.title: The Secret: Be Thankful & Speak Faith
10.truth: Thankfulness and faith-filled words change the atmosphere of prayer and keep your heart aligned with God.
10.challenge: Thank God for three specific things and speak one faith-filled sentence about your day.
questions: What are three things you are thankful for today, and what faith-filled words can you speak?

11.title: ALIGN YOUR SPIRIT (FASTING) (Prayer Elements)
11.truth: Fasting can help align your spirit with God's, quieting the body so the heart can listen.
11.challenge: Set aside one distraction, a screen or a snack, and spend that time praying.
questions: What distracts your spirit most when you pray, and how could fasting help with it?

12.title: Burn: Be Fervent in Spirit (Prayer Elements)
12.truth: Fervent prayer is earnest and heartfelt, offered from a heart that cares deeply for God and for others.
12.challenge: Pray for one person today with warmth and specific words.
questions: Who or what are you praying about with real passion right now?

13.title: Dont You Dare Quit (Prayer Elements)
13.truth: Persistence in prayer is a faithful habit; keep coming back to God even when answers are slow.
13.challenge: Return to a prayer you have paused and pray it once more today.
questions: Which prayer have you wanted to give up on, and what would it mean to keep going?

14.title: Enter with BOLDNESS (Prayer Elements)
14.truth: Boldness in prayer comes through Jesus, who opens the way for us to come confidently to God.
14.challenge: Begin your prayer by saying, 'I come boldly because of Jesus.'
questions: What would change if you came to God with boldness rather than fear?

15.title: Inward Desire (Prayer Elements)
15.truth: Prayer grows from the desires God places within us, and bringing them to Him honestly is good.
15.challenge: Tell God one honest desire in one sentence, then leave it with Him.
questions: What is one desire of your heart you have not yet brought to God in prayer?

16.title: Consecrate the Beginning—Then Navigate
16.truth: Setting apart the start of your day or your prayer for God shapes how you move through what follows.
16.challenge: Give the first five minutes after you wake to God before reaching for your phone.
questions: How could you set apart the start of tomorrow for God?

17.title: Under Pressure or in Glory? Rhythm of a Praying Life
17.truth: Whether life feels pressured or glorious, a steady rhythm of prayer keeps your heart anchored in God.
17.challenge: Pray one prayer of thanks in a good moment and one of trust in a hard one.
questions: What does your prayer rhythm look like in a hard season, and in a good one?

18.title: Success or Suffering: The Secret Rhythm of Jesus
18.truth: Jesus prayed in seasons of success and of suffering, showing that prayer is the rhythm of every season.
18.challenge: Pray for someone in a hard season, and thank God for one good thing.
questions: How has prayer carried you through both good and hard seasons?

19.title: What Satan Missed: The Secret Rhythm That Turns Death into Power
19.truth: Even at the cross Jesus kept to prayer, and through His death and resurrection God turned loss into victory.
19.challenge: Thank Jesus for the cross, and bring one hard thing to Him in prayer today.
questions: How does knowing Jesus won through the cross change how you face your own struggles?

20.title: The Intercession Loop: Why Jesus is Still Praying for You Today
20.truth: Jesus continues to intercede for believers, so your life is held in prayer even on the days you cannot pray.
20.challenge: Thank Jesus for praying for you, then pray for one person by name.
questions: How does knowing Jesus is praying for you change the way you face today?

21.title: INFLUENCE begins via Presence
21.truth: Influence often starts with presence: being near God and near people, quietly and faithfully.
21.challenge: Spend ten minutes of undistracted time with someone you love today.
questions: Who is shaped by your presence, and how could you be more present with them?

daniel-fast-giving-praying-fasting.theme: The three disciplines Jesus assumed in Matthew 6, practised together through the Daniel Fast.

themeScripture.text: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

declaration: I give in secret, because my Father sees what is done in secret.
I pray with a steady rhythm, and I expect Him to answer.
I fast with purpose, and I keep my heart ready for what He is doing.

weeks.question: The three disciplines Jesus assumed in Matthew 6, practised together through the Daniel Fast.

1.title: Impossible? Not in 2026 - Here’s How to 10× Your Results
1.truth: Lasting growth comes from simple disciplines practised day after day, not from hype or quick promises.
1.challenge: Write down one thing you are asking God to grow in you and pray over it once.
questions: What would you like God to grow in you this year, and what small step will you take first?

2.title: Giving, Praying & Fasting: The 3 Things That Change Everything
2.truth: Giving, praying and fasting are three habits Jesus expected His followers to practise, and together they shape a changed life.
2.challenge: Pick one of the three to practise today, however small.
questions: Which of the three do you find easiest, and which would stretch you most?

3.title: Giving Isn’t About Money… So What Is It About?
3.truth: Giving is an act of the heart: trust, love and generosity that go beyond money alone.
3.challenge: Give someone your full attention for five minutes, with your phone put away.
questions: What can you give today that costs time, attention or kindness rather than money?

4.title: Prayer Isn’t Free… It’s an Investment
4.truth: Prayer costs time and effort, and time given to God is never wasted; it deepens trust in Him.
4.challenge: Set aside ten quiet minutes before the day gets busy and pray in them.
questions: What does the time you spend with God show about what you value most right now?

5.title: Fasting Is Not Just Skipping Food, It’s Preparation
5.truth: Fasting is more than going without food; it prepares body, mind and spirit to hear God clearly.
5.challenge: Plan one meal to be simpler today and use that pause to pray.
questions: What might God be preparing you for that needs a clearer heart and mind?

6.title: The Power Trio:Giving, Praying & Fasting
6.truth: When giving, praying and fasting work together, each one strengthens the others and the whole life grows.
6.challenge: Link one act of giving with one prayer and one simpler meal today.
questions: How could one of these support another in your week, for example prayer shaping how you give?

7.title: Fasting Can Be Joyful… If You Do This First
7.truth: Joy in fasting comes from knowing its purpose and keeping your heart turned toward God.
7.challenge: Thank God for three things before you begin your fast or meal today.
questions: What would make this fast feel like a gift to you rather than a burden?

8.title: Most People Miss This When Fasting, Anoint Your Head
8.truth: Jesus said to anoint your head when you fast, so that your fast shows a glad heart and not a gloomy face.
8.challenge: Wash your face, begin with a short prayer of thanks, and let your fast be quiet and glad.
questions: What would it look like to fast with a glad heart instead of a heavy one?

9.title: Don’t Just Fast — OPEN YOUR MOUTH AND DECLARE
9.truth: Faith is spoken as well as held; declaring God's promises out loud gives your faith words and direction.
9.challenge: Say one promise of God out loud twice, then write it on a card.
questions: Which promise of God will you speak out loud this week, and where will you say it?

10.title: The Matthew 6 Secret: How to Fast so the World Doesn't Know
10.truth: Matthew 6 teaches that fasting is between you and your Father, done quietly rather than for applause.
10.challenge: Fast or simplify one meal today without mentioning it to anyone.
questions: How would your fast change if no one at home or school ever knew about it?

11.title: ​Our Father in Heaven: Understanding the Secret to Effective Prayer
11.truth: Jesus taught prayer that begins with relationship: calling God Father, near and holy in heaven.
11.challenge: Begin today's prayer with 'Our Father in heaven' and then speak in your own words.
questions: What does calling God 'Our Father' change about how you come to Him?

12.title: Unlocking Unstoppable Prayer: The Secret of Praying His Will
12.truth: Prayer grows strong when it lines up with God's will, asking for what He has already said He cares about.
12.challenge: Find one Bible promise that matches your prayer request and read it aloud.
questions: What does God's Word say about the request on your heart right now?

13.title: Why Your Prayers Aren't Working (The Missing Ingredient)
13.truth: Many prayers stall when something essential is missing, and honest reflection helps you find what needs to change.
13.challenge: Ask God to show you one thing that may be hindering your prayers, then listen quietly.
questions: What might be missing from your prayers that you have never named before?

14.title: Missing Link to Effective Prayer - The right Spirit
14.truth: The attitude you pray in, humble, sincere and trusting, matters as much as the words you use.
14.challenge: Before you pray, take a breath and ask God for a humble, trusting heart.
questions: What attitude do you bring when you pray, and what attitude would you like to bring?

15.title: The Mystery of Giving, Praying & Fasting
15.truth: Some truths about giving, praying and fasting are learned only by practising them and seeing God at work.
15.challenge: Write one thing you have learned from prayer, giving or fasting this week.
questions: What have you noticed about God during a season of practising these disciplines?

16.title: The Threefold Cord 2: Secret Giving, Praying, and Fasting
16.truth: A threefold cord is hard to break, and giving, praying and fasting done in secret hold a life steady together.
16.challenge: Do one act of secret kindness or giving today and tell no one.
questions: Which of the three cords is weakest in your life right now?

17.title: Atmosphere of Miracles: How JOY Unlocks Giving, Praying, and Fasting
17.truth: Joy makes giving, praying and fasting lighter, and a glad, thankful heart is a good place to meet God.
17.challenge: Spend five minutes thanking and praising God before you pray.
questions: What brings you joy that you could bring into your prayer time?

18.title: The Exponential Results Formula: Giving ^ Praying ^ Fasting
18.truth: Giving, praying and fasting strengthen one another when practised together, but faithfulness matters more than any formula.
18.challenge: Choose one time this week to repeat a discipline you have already started.
questions: What would faithful, steady practice look like for you over the next few weeks?

19.title: The Christalist Mandate: Giving, Praying, and Intentional Fasting
19.truth: The call is to live giving, praying and fasting on purpose, centred on Christ and not on self.
19.challenge: Name the purpose of your next fast in one sentence before you begin.
questions: What would intentional living around Christ look like in your home or school this week?
